composition_variation: Create an original 30-year-old anime woman with long chestnut hair, walking through an empty modern station with a jacket draped over one shoulder. She wears a fully opaque cobalt turtleneck, wide ivory trousers, and loafers. Use clean fashion linework, polished geometric architecture, pale butter-yellow highlights, and a relaxed raised-chin smile. The pose communicates independence through natural stride and balanced anatomy. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
